findings: `learner.components[1].text` gives an unsupported sound comparison: the cited Baxter–Sagart equality is for the separate lexical entries 見 ‘appear’ and 現 ‘appear’, while 見 ‘see’ has a different reconstruction. Since this card explains 見 as the sound element for 現, revise it to identify the comparison as a match between the appearance readings, and keep it distinct from the proposed nasal-prefix derivation of 現 ‘appear’ from 見 ‘see’ (`X-130d7fc37d83e1017e29`, `X-f527116bd13b3114312c`, `X-739e15fdea40cab431ab`).
